drivers.explanation: Active patients have fallen by more than half in 90 days, from 1,782 to 842, and the program is at only 46.8% of forecast, so the program is shrinking well below what Norvale expected.

With the field team reportedly focused elsewhere and new patient starts falling since summer, the manufacturer may be cutting back its investment in this brand program, which puts the $798,700 ARR at risk at renewal.
Weekly portal users halved over 90 days and the executive sponsor has not met in 246 days, so the brand team is disengaging from the program.

tool_input.next_step: Ask Mei to set up a review with the Norvale brand lead and field team leadership this week, bringing the active-patient decline and forecast gap (46.8% attainment) and a plan to restore new patient starts.
